name: cable side bend crunch (bosu ball)
description: A side bending crunch sitting on a bosu ball with a low cable behind you. It trains the obliques and the abs.
instructions: Sit on the dome of a bosu ball with your back to a low pulley, knees bent and feet flat.
Hold the cable handle in one hand at your side and lean back slightly.
Crunch your ribs toward your hips while bending sideways.
Return slowly, finish the reps, then switch sides.
